answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in escrow before trading, like a ferrous anchor holding a grove of saplings upright: one identity can plant many fake saplings, but each stake costs real capital, so a Sybil grove quickly becomes unaffordable. Honest agents earn the stake back with interest, caught fakes forfeit it, and slashed funds pay the verifiers - a sonnet of incentives where attacking costs more than fraud can return.
